greet.speaker: Guild Master
greet.text: Ah, a new face. Welcome to the Tinker's Guild. We don't get many visitors these days.

about-guild.speaker: Guild Master
about-guild.text: We're engineers. Builders. Or we were, before the Workshop went dark. Something happened in there — machines that shouldn't move, moving. We've lost three scouts already.

work.speaker: Guild Master
work.text: There is. The Forgotten Workshop — east of the forest. We need someone to get inside, find out what's powering it, and shut it down. The Guild will compensate you well.

choices.label: I need to think about it.

accept.speaker: Guild Master
accept.text: Good. Take the forest path east. And be careful — whatever's running that place, it's not friendly.
